description:
About the role

You will join the Detection Engineering team at Northwind Cloud Security, building and tuning detections across our SIEM fleet. This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in India, and we offer visa sponsorship for relocation to Singapore if desired.

  • Write and maintain Sigma rules and Splunk ES content for Windows and Linux telemetry
  • Tune false positives with data from CrowdStrike and Microsoft Sentinel
  • Partner with SOC analysts on threat hunting campaigns mapped to MITRE ATT&CK

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in detection engineering, SOC analysis or incident response
  • Strong hands-on experience with Splunk or another SIEM (Elastic, Sentinel)
  • Python scripting for detection automation and enrichment pipelines
  • Familiarity with YARA rules and malware triage fundamentals
  • Fluency in English; German language skills are a plus but not required

Nice to have

  • Splunk Certified Power User or equivalent certification
  • Experience with Terraform-managed detection-as-code workflows

Benefits

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents
  • 25 days of paid time off per year
  • Annual performance bonus and equity grants
  • Home-office stipend and learning budget

Compensation: ₹18 LPA - ₹22 LPA base, plus bonus.
